items.title: Salesforce and Anthropic launch Claudeforce, wiring Claude into Salesforce's CRM and Slack
items.note: 37 prebuilt sales skills let sellers and agents act on live revenue data from inside Claude; Salesforce stock jumped 12% on the news

items.title: Google's A2A protocol formally joins the Agentic AI Foundation alongside Anthropic's MCP
items.note: one neutral governance body now hosts both major agent protocols; AAIF has grown past 250 members including AWS, Google, Microsoft and OpenAI

items.title: Personal AI agent startup Instinct raises $250M Series B at a $2.5B valuation
items.note: Index Ventures and Benchmark lead; valuation up roughly 5x in weeks on viral consumer demand

items.title: Keenable raises $26M seed to build web-search infrastructure built for AI agents
items.note: 100B-document index tuned for low-latency agent queries like pricing monitoring and lead enrichment; Google and Amazon execs among the angels

items.title: US foreclosure filings rise 10% year-over-year in July, ATTOM reports
items.note: 39,906 properties filed; Nevada, South Carolina and Florida post the highest foreclosure rates

items.title: Mortgage rates hold steady at 6.66% for the 30-year loan
items.note: Freddie Mac's weekly survey shows rates barely moving, still near a 13-month high

items.title: SanDisk cuts Israeli jobs as it shifts development work to India
items.note: layoffs hit Kfar Saba, Tefen and Omer sites despite record ~$9B quarterly revenue and a $91B order backlog
